bio_1: I partner with emerging and established brands to bridge the gap between raw aesthetic vision and flawless factory execution. As a trained fashion designer and the creative director behind Valour Clothing Co., I understand that scaling an apparel brand requires more than just applying good graphics to blank garments—it requires engineering.​​​​​​​
bio_2:
Many brands struggle to translate their unique visual identity into garments that manufacturers can actually produce without costly errors. My focus is entirely on closing that gap. I don’t just design clothing; I engineer your ideas, so they survive the sample room.
I adapt completely to your custom design language to handle the end-to-end development pipeline. From initial trend research, custom graphic development, and rendering to complex cut-and-sew silhouettes and precise, factory-ready tech packs, I ensure your exact specifications are communicated flawlessly to the factory floor.
Whether you are launching a highly focused micro-capsule or a comprehensive seasonal drop, I provide the technical blueprints and creative direction required to elevate your final product and protect your investment.
